summary: Recent updates to the HTMLMediaElement in Firefox focus on improving how audio and video media elements interact with the user and underlying systems. Notably, media elements will now **yield to and recover from audio-session interruptions**, such as phone calls or alarms, ensuring a smoother experience for users. This also includes a new feature to officially implement a loading attribute for video and audio elements, which informs users about the media's loading status. Additionally, changes have been made to how the *runtime muted* attribute behaves, including tracking when it is engaged and making its use an experimental option for testing _without impacting regular users_. Together, these enhancements improve media playback reliability and responsiveness across various scenarios.
